scope: Primary theorem statements, displayed formulas, conventions and required hypotheses inspected. The complete external proofs are not re-proved by this author audit. PDF-page counts distinguish the inspected version from the journal citation.

PollicottSharpZeta.checked: Selberg product is over all primitive conjugacy classes, with no quotient by inversion; compact oriented genus at least two. The chapter supplies the continuation argument from its assumed remainder.

BJPZeta.pin: Theorem 1.1, page 483; Theorem 4.1 and equation (4.2), page 494
BJPZeta.checked: Spectral zeros are resonances with multiplicity. In the compact case positive Laplace eigenvalues below 1/4 supply zeros s in (1/2,1). No cusp pole occurs there.

EdwardsOhMixing.version: Author PDF corresponding to Duke Math. J. 170 (2021), 3417-3458
EdwardsOhMixing.pin: Theorem 1.1 and Remark 1.1, author pages 2-3; non-tempered unitary-dual description, page 4
EdwardsOhMixing.checked: Finite-volume specialization with critical exponent d=1 has every Sobolev rate below 1-s1. The nontrivial non-tempered PSL2(R) representations are spherical complementary series.

GNDiscrepancy.version: J. Theor. Nombres Bordeaux 36 (2024), 127-174, publisher PDF
GNDiscrepancy.pin: Section 1.3 and Theorem 1.4, pages 131-132; Section 5, Theorem 5.2, page 148
GNDiscrepancy.checked: Exact factor 2 times congruence index times real-ball volume inverse; simply connected K-simple group, noncompact real factor, unramified S, bounded positive-measure hyperspecial bi-invariant set, discretely embedded irreducible representation, representation-dependent small radius.

SharpZeta.version: 12-page author's revised version cited in the bibliography
SharpZeta.pin: Section 4, PDF page 8; definitions in Section 1
SharpZeta.checked: Fixed-point trace and reciprocal determinant identities. Extension from a zero-one state graph to an integer adjacency matrix uses its edge shift, as explained in the chapter.

BabillotMixing.version: 13-page full-text PDF of the cited 2002 paper
BabillotMixing.pin: Quasi-product definition and Theorem 1, PDF page 6; finite-measure discussion, page 7
BabillotMixing.checked: Simply connected complete negative-curvature cover with curvature bounded above by a negative constant; non-elementary discrete group. Current equivalent to a product of boundary probability measures. Nonarithmeticity yields mixing; the chapter assumes a finite nonzero measure.

DolgopyatMixing.checked: Discussion explicitly distinguishes suspension/roof obstructions from discrete-time mixing. The chapter's constant-roof counterexample is derived independently.

WentworthGardiner.checked: Filling pair iff a unique marked conformal structure and holomorphic quadratic differential realizes it; intersection equals flat area.

AranaHerreraSquare2020.version: arXiv v1, 14 February 2019, 27 pages; journal citation is J. Mod. Dyn. 16 (2020)
AranaHerreraSquare2020.pin: Theorem 1.6, PDF page 4; unfolding stabilizer denominator in equation (1.4), pages 4-5, and Section 3
AranaHerreraSquare2020.checked: Equivariant homeomorphism to filling pairs, integral pairs to square tilings, and area to intersection; simultaneous-quotient weights retain pair stabilizers.

AranaHerreraSquareEffective.version: arXiv v1, 8 July 2022, 13 pages; journal reference 45 (2025), 649-662
AranaHerreraSquareEffective.pin: Theorem 1.1 and Remark 1.2, PDF page 3; Theorem 3.2 and proof, pages 8-9; Theorem 3.9, page 12
AranaHerreraSquareEffective.checked: Area exponent is complex stratum dimension. The two-type effective count uses existing exponential mixing. One unrestricted foliation type permits ordinary lattice counting. The baseline citation to Section 3.2 was corrected to Theorem 3.2.

ABEMPolar.version: arXiv v5 header dated 17 September 2011; served 45-page PDF has title-page compilation date 26 November 2024
ABEMPolar.pin: Section 2.2; Section 2.4, equation (2.3), Proposition 2.5, PDF page 9; Theorem 3.3 and Section 3.2, pages 15-16
ABEMPolar.checked: Polar Jacobian and conditional fiber measure; asymptotic requires compact principal-stratum endpoints and at least half-time recurrence to a compact principal-stratum set. Forni's contraction enters the asymptotic, not the exact unfolding. Probability rescaling is derived in the chapter.

AranaHerreraLattice.pin: Introduction, pages 1-3; Section 10, pages 47-50; Theorem 3.2, page 10
AranaHerreraLattice.checked: Effective bisector counts are proved using exponential mixing; cited as a dependency warning, not an independent input establishing the proposed converse remainder.

HumphriesModular.version: 11-page arXiv PDF inspected; corresponding journal paper Quart. J. Math. 73 (2022), 1-16
HumphriesModular.checked: Inverse-residue Fourier coefficient and Weil bound tau(c)*sqrt(c*gcd(m,n,c)); smoothing estimates in the chapter are then elementary.

BenirschkeServan.version: 20-page author's original corresponding to Advances in Mathematics 452 (2024), 109817
BenirschkeServan.checked: Only the classical hyperelliptic isometry T(2,0)=T(0,6) is used. The general embedding classification is not required for the polynomial Q(2,2) argument.

erratum.pin: 3-page author's erratum, page 1 and final paragraph on page 3
erratum.checked: Repairs original Remark 5.2 and the holomorphic-map argument; says results unchanged. Also narrows the wording about totally geodesic complex submanifolds. No impact on the classical isometry used here.

FillastreIzmestievCusps.checked: Constant-curvature sphere cone metric with positive singular curvature has unique convex polyhedral realization in the matching space form. The chapter uses K=-1 and six angle-pi vertices.

LanneauComponents.version: Ann. Sci. ENS 41 (2008), 1-56, publisher PDF with cover sheet
LanneauComponents.pin: Sections 1.1.1-1.1.2, printed pages 3-6; Section 1.1.3, printed pages 7-8
LanneauComponents.checked: Quadratic Q notation excludes global squares; period-coordinate and invariant measure conventions; marked regular points allowed; pullback order/covering construction. The chapter proves its particular genus-two classification directly.

StrombergssonVishe.checked: Rank-one unipotent and rank-two trivial frequency stabilizer types. The chapter independently unfolds using its right-quotient and transpose conventions.

BenoistKobayashi.version: 34-page author PDF of Tempered homogeneous spaces II
BenoistKobayashi.pin: Lemma 2.3 and Remark 2.4, PDF page 11; Proposition 2.6, page 12
BenoistKobayashi.checked: Induction preserves temperedness; amenable groups have tempered trivial representation; K-finite matrix-coefficient bound with square roots of K-span dimensions.

CowlingHaagerupHowe.pin: Exact theorem statement inspected through BenoistKobayashi Proposition 2.6, which cites original Theorems 1, 2 and Corollary
CowlingHaagerupHowe.checked: Historical attribution retained. Original full-text endpoints were unavailable (404/access failure); no claim of inspecting or re-proving the original proof. The operative statement was verified in the primary research text Benoist-Kobayashi.

OtalRosas.pin: Discrete spectrum definition, PDF page 2; Theorem 2, page 3
OtalRosas.checked: Finite-area type (g,n), lambda_0=0, residual and cuspidal eigenvalues both included. lambda_(2g-2+n)>1/4; at type (0,3) no positive small eigenvalue. This is not asserted for arbitrary congruence covers.

AthreyaLagaceMollerRaum.version: J. Spectr. Theory 15 (2025), 895-959, publisher PDF; arXiv 2404.06597v1 also inspected
AthreyaLagaceMollerRaum.pin: Section 6.1; Proposition 6.11, printed page 954 (also arXiv v1 page 47); genuine-part decomposition in Section 1 and Proposition 3.9
AthreyaLagaceMollerRaum.checked: One relative marked vector, not the two-relative-mark model of this chapter. M=1 affine mean/variance isometry and absence of complementary series in the genuine part; the chapter supplies its own two-mark rank decomposition.

AthreyaAffineLattices.checked: Affine lattice point counts in bounded measurable regions have mean equal to volume and variance equal to volume. Used as a corroborating indicator-test special case.

McShaneRivinTori.pin: Length norm in Sections 1-2; Theorems 4.1-4.2 and Conjecture 4.3, PDF pages 7-8
McShaneRivinTori.checked: Fixed once-punctured hyperbolic torus; primitive lattice count, dense-moduli flat-point obstruction, modular-torus conjecture. The chapter separately proves only the stated exponent-one obstruction, not literal Omega(L).

ShigaHyperbolicQC.version: Publisher reprint, Complex Variables 50 (2005), 123-130, with cover sheet
ShigaHyperbolicQC.checked: Wolpert inequality K^-1*l_X <= l_Y <= K*l_X for closed geodesic classes under K-quasiconformal maps; chapter also supplies annular-cover proof and Lie-bracket derivative argument.
